title: Workspace brief (PRs / issues / tasks)
description: Refresh GitHub digest for selected repos and summarize open PRs, issues, and local tasks. Run once or attach Cron — not a plugin.
goalTemplate:
Workspace brief for repositories {{repositories}}. Cadence context: {{checkFrequency}} ({{timezone}}).

1) For each selected workspace id, run `ncc ai workflows refresh` with that workspace active (or refresh via tool) so Issues/PRs are current.
2) Run `ncc ai workflows show` / read digest — summarize open PRs, issues, and todo/doing tasks.
3) Optionally note lifecycle: `ncc ai workflow lifecycle --workspace <id> --json`.
4) If digest refresh fails: report the error clearly (auth / no workspace / gh). Do NOT invent PRs.
5) If nothing is open: say so in one line — no fake empty spam.
6) Do not merge, do not write files, do not archive.
